gaps.sentence: With careful ___ (PREPARE), the trek is perfectly safe.

gaps.explanation: 'Optimistic' is the adjective; 'optimism' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: ___ (PERSIST) rain ruined the first two days of the festival.
gaps.explanation: An adjective is needed before 'rain': persistent; 'persistence' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: She was ___ (GRATE) for all their support.
He is one of the most ___ (INFLUENCE) thinkers of the decade.
gaps.explanation: 'Influential' describes a person who influences others.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (SUSPECT) of fraud last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Was suspected of' — passive; 'suspicious' describes a person who suspects.
'A tendency to do something' — noun from tend.
